---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What user need or workflow gap does this address? Concrete examples
help (e.g. "a sponsor uploaded 12 CRFs from an old vendor and the
router misclassified 4 of them as messy_tabular").

## Proposed solution

How would it look in the UI / API / config?

## Alternatives considered

If you weighed multiple designs, list the trade-offs.

## Risk / privacy notes

Especially important for anything touching ingestion, cleansing, or
LLM payloads — does this change what data leaves the user's machine?

## Are you willing to implement it?

(Y/N) — and roughly which milestone makes sense.
